en: Illustrated Art Nouveau–style postcard showing the back of a red‑haired girl or woman bathing in pale yellow water, with orange reflections and dark patches suggesting shadows or rocks. She has a flower in her hair and is turned in profile. In the lower left of the main image there is a small white swan and a dragonfly. The illustration is framed on a pink background. At the bottom left is a circular emblem or logo, and near the bottom center is a printed website address.
